identifications.note: This arc COUNTS the freedom in the crossing's only remaining target and performs no comparison; F2 is untouched and nothing is read. Its consequence for the row is a RECOMMENDATION NOT TO SPEND IT: R11's arithmetic (outputs - consumed anchors > 0, else vacuous by MB12) fails on either branch, because the mirror set is ONE row while the residual freedom is a 48-fold discrete selection (log2 48 ~ 5.58 bits) or, if the whole orbit is used, a 48-element target set. I-13's price is therefore now KNOWN and UNAFFORDABLE at present outputs, which is a sharper statement than 'unearned' -- the crossing is not blocked by missing effort but by an arithmetic that does not close.

claim_one_line: THE MIRROR SECTOR POSED: THE RESIDUAL FREEDOM IS 48, AND R11'S ARITHMETIC SAYS DO NOT SPEND THE LAST ROW. Of KIND_TABLE's four coupling rows, tones, probability and phases are all CONSUMED with decisive MISSes and the MIRROR SET (theta-even) is the last licensed row, delivered by B1011 C6 and never drawn on by any sealed comparison; the one-shot rule consumes CONTACT ROWS, so it is spent whatever the outcome. B1348 posed the theta-ODD plane, which is NOT the crossing target; this poses the right one. CONTROLS: the canonical rational basis from the weights (e(0,0), e(1,1), e(0,1)+e(1,0), e(0,2)+e(2,0)) satisfies C v = +v; <R,L> restricts exactly; the PROJECTIVE IMAGE IS 720 = 12 x 60 = A_4 x A_5, as forced since (-1,-1) and (-1,1) act as scalars on V_2 (x) V_2; C^4_even is IRREDUCIBLE; and a random direction has |Stab| = 1 with orbit 720. THE STABILISER SPECTRUM, every orbit size dividing 720 as orbit-stabiliser requires: |Stab| = 15, 10, 9, 6, 5, 3, 2 giving orbits 48, 72, 80, 120, 144, 240, 360. MAXIMAL |Stab| = 15, SO THE SMALLEST DISTINGUISHED ORBIT HAS 48 ELEMENTS -- four times the odd plane's 12. The structure is confirmed rather than assumed: 15 = 3 x 5 = (tetrahedral vertex stabiliser) x (icosahedral vertex stabiliser), and the maximal-stabiliser direction is RANK 1, singular values [1,0], a PRODUCT STATE v (x) w. METHOD CORRECTION recorded not hidden: a first pass orbit-decomposed by rounding projective coordinates and produced sizes that DO NOT DIVIDE 720 (68, 370, 423...), impossible by orbit-stabiliser; that enumeration is WITHDRAWN and the table is derived from stabiliser orders alone with |orbit| = 720/|Stab| -- the same float-drift failure as B1348's withdrawn step 4, caught by an invariant the answer must satisfy. R11'S ARITHMETIC, THE POINT OF THE ARC: on branch A (the row needs one direction) the anchor cost is a 48-FOLD DISCRETE SELECTION, log2 48 ~ 5.58 bits; on branch B (the row uses the whole orbit) there is no selection but the prediction becomes a 48-ELEMENT SET, a 48-fold look-elsewhere on the comparison side; and the mirror row is ONE row, so ON EITHER BRANCH OUTPUTS MINUS ANCHORS IS NEGATIVE AND R11 DECLARES THE CELL VACUOUS BEFORE THE SEAL. RECOMMENDATION, STATED AS A RESULT: DO NOT SPEND THE LAST ROW -- not now, and on this arithmetic not through this row at all, unless the mirror set's value set is shown to carry MORE THAN ONE independent output, in which case the outputs are recounted and R11 re-evaluated. Three of four rows are spent with decisive misses and the fourth is unrepeatable, so a gating computation that says NO is worth more than a fourth miss and costs less. WHAT WOULD CHANGE IT: count the mirror set's independent outputs (k > 5.6 bits closes the ledger); cut the 48 (the Galois question at the point level is OPEN, B1348's withdrawal having left it so); or add a new licensed row under R5 in advance, derived not fitted since F1 forbids fitting. FENCES: F2 untouched, no comparison performed, no value read, I-13 still UNEARNED, R4/R5/R10 left as banked. The exactification debt B1348 registered applies to both arcs. NUMBERING: this takes B1349, the last id before the reserved range B1350-B1399 (E71); the next new arc on this branch needs a range grant. ADDENDUM (same branch, NOT a new arc -- B1350-B1399 is reserved, so the work discharging B1349's own debt is banked here). (1) THE EXACTIFICATION OWED BY B1348 AND B1349 IS PAID: the instrument is rebuilt in exact Q(zeta_60) = Q[z]/Phi_60, every exponent landing in (1/15)Z so every entry is a Z-combination of zeta_60 powers (T = diag(z15^-2, z15^2, z15^8, z15^2, z15^7, z15^8); S = -i/(5 sqrt3) sum_w sgn(w) z15^{-3<w(l+rho),m+rho>} with i = zeta_60^15 and sqrt3 = zeta_60^5 + zeta_60^-5), and every control passes with NO FLOAT ANYWHERE: S Sdag = I, S = S^T, C = S^2 has entries in {0,1} and IS the charge conjugation (a,b) -> (b,a), and (ST)^3 = S^2. The integers both arcs' verdicts rest on are unchanged. (2) GALOIS DOES CUT, AND MEASURABLY: a direction with RATIONAL coordinates in the weight basis is fixed by every sigma in Gal(Q(zeta_60)/Q) automatically, so the question becomes how many distinguished directions are rational -- and that number, not the orbit size, is what R7 prices. theta-ODD: 12 -> 2 RATIONAL ([1:0] and [0:1], i.e. f1 and f2), cost log2 2 = 1 bit. theta-EVEN (the crossing target): 8 RATIONAL of the 96 maximal-stabiliser directions, cost log2 8 = 3 BITS, down from 5.58. The eight are the four canonical weight basis vectors plus four more with entries in {0, 1, -1/2}. STRUCTURE: the 96 are TWO orbits of 48, forced because A_4 has TWO classes of stabiliser-3 points (vertices and faces, four each), 2 x (4 x 12) = 96; the 4/4 split of the rationals between them is INDICATED, NOT ESTABLISHED. (3) R11 RECOMPUTED: anchor cost falls from 5.58 bits to 3 bits while outputs stay at 1, so outputs - anchors moves from -4.6 to -2. STILL SHORT, BUT THE RECOMMENDATION CHANGES SHAPE -- from 'not through this row at all' to 'ONE MORE OUTPUT THAN THREE AND IT CLOSES': if the mirror set's exact value set carries at least 4 independent numbers the ledger balances and the arc becomes worth its one shot. That is a concrete checkable follow-up where before there was none. (4) TWO ERRORS CAUGHT AND RECORDED: the rationality test first ACCEPTED 1/phi, because with tol 1e-8 and denominators to 10^4 the Fibonacci ratio 4181/6765 approximates it to ~1e-8 -- in an instrument whose value set is the golden nine that is the worst possible false positive; fixed to tol 1e-11 and denominators to 1000, WITH A CONTROL asserting the test rejects 1/phi and accepts -1/2, and the reported 14 became 8. And the orbit enumeration drifted a THIRD time, reporting sizes [48, 68] with 68 not dividing 720; the 48 and the two-orbit structure rest on orbit-stabiliser and on A_4's two stabiliser-3 classes, and the enumeration is used for no banked number. (5) THE RECOMMENDATION NOW: still do not spend the row yet, but the reason has moved from structural to arithmetic by a measurable margin, and the next step is no longer 'cut the 48' -- that is done, 48 -> 8 -- it is COUNT HOW MANY INDEPENDENT NUMBERS THE theta-EVEN MIRROR SET CARRIES. Four suffices.
